tw: Kron walks sideways down the sidewalk while a stalk of corn walks beside him.
twc: Kron 横着走过人行道，一根玉米秆在旁边跟着走。
hint: 人行道上，玉米也会走路。

tw: Kron rides a cross zebra across the zebra crossing, and the zebra won't stop braying.
twc: Kron 骑着生气的斑马过斑马线，斑马一路叫个不停。
hint: 斑马线上，真斑马不乐意。

tw: Kron's slow go-kart overtakes a tortoise, then the tortoise takes over the kart.
twc: Kron 开卡丁车超过乌龟，结果乌龟接管了方向盘。
hint: 超过乌龟，被乌龟夺了车。

tw: Kron locks a clock in a box, and the clock knocks back: tock, tock!
twc: Kron 把闹钟锁进盒子，闹钟在里面咚咚敲门。
hint: 锁住了钟，锁不住滴答。

tw: Kron reads the programme proudly as a gramophone plays his grandma's polka.
twc: Kron 骄傲地念节目单，留声机放着奶奶的波尔卡。
hint: 节目单第一项：奶奶跳舞。

tw: Kron repeats "Pete, eat the peach!" and the parrot Pete repeats it, eating Kron's peach.
twc: Kron 教鹦鹉皮特说“吃桃”，它边重复边吃掉了桃。
hint: 学舌学到嘴里去了。

tw: Kron receives a sleeve from Steve, and Steve's arm is still in the sleeve.
twc: Kron 收到史蒂夫寄来的一只袖子，史蒂夫的手还在里面。
hint: 收到的包裹还带着胳膊。

tw: Kron can't stand the band on the sand, so he stands on his hands.
twc: Kron 受不了沙滩上的乐队，干脆倒立着走开。
hint: 受不了，就倒过来受。

tw: Five bad drums drive Dad mad as Kron jives at five.
twc: Kron 早上五点敲五面鼓，把老爸逼疯了。
hint: 凌晨五点的鼓，最逼疯人。

tw: Kron takes a test in a nest, the best guest among the chicks.
twc: Kron 挤在鸟窝里和小鸟一起考试，是最用功的客人。
hint: 鸟妈妈监考，最紧张的是他。

tw: Kron must hold on to the old goat's coat as it rolls down the slope.
twc: Kron 死死抓住老山羊的毛，一起滚下山坡。
hint: 一抓紧，就停不下来。

tw: Well built Kron lifts the whole village well, bell and bucket, built of stone.
twc: 壮实的 Kron 把村里整口石井连铃带桶举了起来。
hint: 身强力壮，连井都拔起来。

tw: Kron waves at a wavy navy wave, and the wave waves back.
twc: Kron 朝一道深蓝的波浪招手，波浪也向他招手。
hint: 波浪形的海，真会打招呼。

tw: Sociable Kron shares soda with a shy bull and a sleepy sheep on the bus.
twc: 爱交际的 Kron 在公交上给害羞的公牛和困羊分汽水。
hint: 整车都是他的新朋友。

tw: Humorous Kron tells a huge rumour to a moose, and the moose roars with humour.
twc: 幽默的 Kron 给驼鹿讲了个大传闻，驼鹿笑得直吼。
hint: 一个笑话笑翻一头驼鹿。

tw: Kron sits uncomfortable under a comfy fort of four tables and one bun.
twc: Kron 窝在四张桌子搭的“舒服”堡垒下，浑身难受。
hint: 堡垒很舒服，里面的他不。

tw: Good-looking Kron looks at his good looks in the cook's big spoon.
twc: 帅气的 Kron 对着厨师的大勺照了又照。
hint: 勺子里的自己最好看。

tw: A cute mule offers Kron its used shoes, and Kron refuses: "No use!"
twc: 可爱的骡子把旧鞋送给 Kron，Kron 拒绝：“没用！”
hint: 骡子的鞋，送都不要。

tw: Kron will not knot any more ropes, and many more ropes knot him.
twc: Kron 发誓不再打绳结，结果更多绳子把他打成了结。
hint: 不打结了，换绳子打他。

tw: Kron overreacts over one raindrop, rowing a raft over the road in a raincoat.
twc: 一滴雨落下，Kron 穿着雨衣划着木筏在干马路上逃。
hint: 一滴雨，他当成了洪水。
